inputs.text: Open your eyes to what they are really doing behind the scenes. They want us to believe this is a standard legal process, but it is all a carefully managed script by the hidden elites pulling the strings. Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process, is just being sacrificed in a ritual of scapegoating to divert attention from the real beneficiaries. We are fed the official line about the irregular acquisition of land for a cemetery, purchased at Ksh.283 million even though it was unsuitable, and told that money has been recovered. Do not fall for the courtroom theater. The institutions orchestrating these financial flows from the top are simply staging her takedown to protect the greater conspiracy and conceal where the Ksh.283 million payout actually went.
